observed.quality: surfable but not ideal: a few decent waves
observed.notes: Montrose Beach, SUP surfing inside the hook. A few decent waves early in chaotic seas; they became organized, then fizzled out.
photos: Sunrise looking out past the Montrose hook breakwater: 1-2 ft wind waves breaking in several crooked lines, whitewater on the outer bar, a paddler catching one

spots.note: surf zone off Montrose Beach: breaking waves, chaotic early, organized later, then fizzling
